title: Agent skill: /theme-styling — Theme a Powerhouse editor or drive-app UI correctly in light and dark.
content:
## When to use
Theme a Powerhouse editor or drive-app UI correctly in light and dark. Covers the bai token system ([data-bai-theme] + --bai-* vars + ThemeProvider, for vault-style packages) and design-system semantic tokens (--foreground/--background/--primary + .dark, for packages built on document-engineering, e.g. the invoice demo) plus theming third-party widgets (Select, DatePicker) whose dark: variants never generate in a consumer build, and native widgets (date/select/checkbox) via color-scheme/accent-color. Read before building or restyling any editor UI.

## What it covers
- Two systems — pick the one that matches the package
- System A: the bai token system
- System B: design-system semantic tokens
- Third-party widget theming — the invoice lesson
- Native browser widgets
- Verification checklist

## Where the full skill lives
- Vault source: **Agent skill: theme-styling** (full text, DERIVED_FROM below) — the vault is this skill's home.

## Invocation
Read the vault source content and follow it. Not a plugin command.
